verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships one official surface, a self-hosted web app. Its docs say outright it is "a self-hosted web app, not a desktop installer," and the docs hub points users who want a desktop installer elsewhere. That web interface goes well beyond chat basics, with agents, MCP tools, memory, scheduled chats, web search and code execution. The evidence shows no official desktop or mobile app, so the multi-surface part of the story is undelivered. Missing for 10: an official desktop app, an official mobile app, documented feature parity across surfaces, and a hosted official web offering rather than self-install only.
